soothingGel.source: 한국피부과학연구원 BEF067·BFA189-PHB 및 프리더마 PDGE-111-CT-26615 1차 draft 결과보고서

en.name: Daily Relief Calming Soothing Gel
en.benefit: A refreshing gel for oily, combination, heat-stressed, or blemish-prone skin.
clinical: Skin temperature decreased by 10.041°C immediately after one application following heat stimulation (N=22, p<0.001)
Redness recovery after heat stimulation: 63.829% (untreated: 7.838%; N=22, p<0.001)
Skin hydration increased by 61.23% immediately after one use (N=22, p<0.001)
Skin hydration increased by 20.20% after 24 hours (N=22, p<0.001)
Immediate surface hydration improved by 76.04% (N=22, p<0.001)
Transepidermal water loss improved by 15.42% (N=22, p<0.001)
Sebum level improved by 15.77% after 2 weeks (N=23, p<0.05)

zh.name: 每日舒缓镇静凝胶

clinical: 热刺激后单次涂抹，皮肤温度即时降低10.041°C（N=22，p<0.001）
单次使用后皮肤含水量即时提升61.23%（N=22，p<0.001）

ja.name: デイリーリリーフ カーミングスージングジェル

clinical: 温熱刺激後の1回塗布直後、皮膚温度が10.041°C低下（N=22、p<0.001）
温熱刺激後の赤み回復率63.829%（無塗布部位7.838%、N=22、p<0.001）
1回使用直後の皮膚水分量が61.23%増加（N=22、p<0.001）
24時間後の皮膚水分量が20.20%増加（N=22、p<0.001）
即時の表面水分量が76.04%改善（N=22、p<0.001）
経皮水分蒸散量が15.42%改善（N=22、p<0.001）
2週間使用後の皮脂量が15.77%改善（N=23、p<0.05）
